name: Microsoft Sentinel KQL detection opportunities
description: Works through each attack procedure and produces telemetry requirements, up to five time-bounded KQL detections with ATT&CK, tuning and schema notes, and a hypotheses table. Use it to turn a report into Sentinel detections for review.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the report(s), article text or analyst notes to analyse. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Product or service
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The intelligence product you deliver to stakeholders.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Test queries in the SIEM
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Run each generated query read-only against your connected SIEM to check that it parses and see the hit volume. Rules are never saved or deployed.

name: Convert detection rules to Splunk SPL
description: Extracts every detection rule in the material and converts it to Splunk SPL beside the original, marking approximations and documenting translation fidelity. Use it to port Sigma, YARA, Snort or KQL rules to Splunk.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the detection rules or the reports that contain them. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Product or service
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The intelligence product you deliver to stakeholders.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Test queries in the SIEM
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Run each generated query read-only against your connected SIEM to check that it parses and see the hit volume. Rules are never saved or deployed.

name: Detection, validation and handoff packages
description: For each evidenced TTP, produces a Sigma rule with telemetry, SIEM portability notes, evasions, false-positive tuning and a validation test, then a deployment priority table and detection gaps. Use it to hand detections to the SOC ready to test and deploy.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the report(s), article text or analyst notes to analyse. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Product or service
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The intelligence product you deliver to stakeholders.

name: Draft detection rules (Sigma or another format)
description: Drafts one experimental detection rule per detectable behavior or indicator set from validated TTPs and IOCs, in Sigma or another chosen format with the validator to run. Use it after IOC extraction and ATT&CK mapping to give the SOC rules to validate.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the validated TTPs and IOCs (or the report). Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Rule format
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Detection format of the generated rules.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Test queries in the SIEM
manual_trigger_parameters.description: For Microsoft Sentinel KQL, Splunk SPL, Elastic EQL or CrowdStrike Falcon LogScale: run each rule's query read-only against your connected SIEM to check that it parses and see the hit volume. Rules are never saved or deployed.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Write to an OpenCTI draft
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Put the rules (as indicators) in a new OpenCTI draft for analyst review, and report the draft id. When off, nothing is written.
